**380 commits, 37 matter.** Draft is in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3). The rest is 153 chores, 73 refactors, 64 tests, 33 CI jobs.

Three things you may not have known were breaking. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`. The v1 export route is gone. Internal error types are no longer re-exported.

| Section | Items | From |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Breaking | 3 | 1 fix, 2 refactors |
| Added | 1 | the only `feat` |
| Fixed | 9 | 25 commits, deduped |

Two calls to check. I dated it `2026-08-29`. And I left the 10 `perf` commits out, since none carry a number. Add a line if you have benchmarks.
